This barley plot is small, only a quarter hectare, but the land is mine and barley has fed my family for many years. I went to school a little, so I know DAP and urea help the barley grow thicker heads, and last season I used some fertilizer from the cooperative — I will do the same this year if the bags come in time. I keep two oxen and a few sheep, so I have manure from the kraal that I spread before ploughing. I will use my own saved seed like most of my neighbors — the improved barley seed is not always at the cooperative and costs more than I can spare, and my saved seed has done well enough on this land.
